prompts.prompt: Which small part of your day do you most wish I could have witnessed this week?
What kind of message from me feels most supportive during a busy workday?
Which time of day makes the distance feel easiest, and what is different about that moment?
What ordinary errand would you enjoy doing together if we shared the same neighborhood today?
Which detail about your current space would help me picture your daily life more accurately?
What should I ask about more often without making you feel monitored?
Which shared ritual would make the start or end of our calls feel warmer?
When plans change suddenly, what response from me helps you feel considered?
What part of planning our next visit feels exciting, and what part creates pressure?
Which photo, voice note, or short message from our relationship still makes you smile?
What is one thing you have handled independently that you want me to notice?
Which future ordinary morning together can you imagine most clearly?
How can we signal that we need a quiet call rather than a high-energy activity?
What topic have we postponed because calls never seem to have the right timing?
Which local place would you show me first if I arrived in your city tomorrow?
What does a reliable week of communication look like when both of us are busy?
Which difference in our routines has taught you something useful about me?
What kind of surprise feels caring from far away without creating obligation or expense?
When you miss me, do you usually want comfort, distraction, planning, or something else?
Which shared decision would you like us to make before our next in-person visit?
What boundary helps our calls feel chosen rather than required?
Which recent moment made you feel proud of how we handle distance as a team?
What is one realistic way we can make next week feel more connected?
What would you like our final sentence on tonight's call to help you carry into tomorrow?
